Connect the physical system

  1. Start START_SENTINEL.bat on the laptop.
  2. For LAN devices, set SENTINEL_HOST=0.0.0.0 before starting. Allow port 8765 on your trusted private network.
  3. Read your device token from website/data/.device_token. Keep it in device settings.
  4. Send JSON to POST /api/hardware/telemetry and raw JPEGs to POST /api/hardware/frame, using X-Device-Token.
  5. Poll the returned event's /api/events/{id} for the actual detection result.

MATCH YOUR FIRMWARE BRANCH

Direct-trigger wiring reference

Two-board build
ConnectionMain ESP32 / destination
PIR outputMain GPIO13
HC-SR04 TRIGMain GPIO5
HC-SR04 ECHOVoltage-divider tap → main GPIO18
Camera triggerMain GPIO19 → ESP32-CAM GPIO13 (direct signal wire)
Common groundMain ESP32 GND ↔ ESP32-CAM GND ↔ sensor grounds
Trigger pull-down resistorTrigger node → resistor → GND; a branch to ground, not in series between GPIO19 and camera GPIO13
Alternative firmware branches use different pins. Use the matching sketch and wiring guide. HC-SR04 ECHO is a 5 V signal: use its voltage divider before GPIO18. A trigger pulse alone does not prove camera capture, upload or readiness.

VISUAL INTELLIGENCE

People, animals, and uncertainty.

The dashboard uses a COCO-pretrained YOLO11n detector to locate people and supported animals. Each box has a class label and confidence score. A 70% threshold is the starting setting, not a measured accuracy claim.

Person presence takes priority when both people and animals are detected. No accepted detection is labeled unconfirmed, not proof of an empty scene.

Video analysis samples up to 120 frames across a clip. Peak counts are counts within a sampled frame, not unique tracked individuals. Events between samples may be missed.

PROJECT STATUS

What is established.

  • Historical five-photo camera uploads recorded
  • Static-image YOLO inference reported working
  • This dashboard provides image/video inference and telemetry APIs
  • Physical hardware must be connected to the new APIs
  • ML-to-controller buzzer operation needs physical validation
  • Identity and authorization recognition are not implemented here
MEASURE BEFORE YOU CLAIM

Evaluate in the real environment.

Test people, animals, empty scenes, partial occlusion, and changing light. Record precision, recall, false alerts, missed events, inference time, and sensor-to-alert delay.

Connect your inference service

The website uses your laptop's Python service for real detection and hardware data.

Use the local website for LAN hardware. A hosted website may need an HTTPS service and browser local-network permission.

Start the service by opening START_SENTINEL.bat in the website folder. Uploaded originals are removed after processing; annotated frames and event records remain on your laptop.
